about.title: A gae is a broken piece of a pot.
paragraphs: We thought that is how African knowledge feels right now: fragmented and scattered everywhere, with bits of our stories, languages and traditions disappearing quietly.
Gae is our attempt to pick those pieces back up and put them together in a living digital archive, so they are not lost for good.

We interview elders, healers, rainmakers and artisans; photograph communities and wildlife; keep proper records of artefacts and indigenous knowledge; and dig into African beliefs, like why some animals are seen as bad omens, to work out what is myth and what carries real meaning.
